storyText: We woke up after sleeping in a tent a few hundred feet away from a gas station (the ONLY gas station within 60+ miles), anyways we wake up and walk towards the gas station to get to the street and begin hitch hiking when Kalaheo asked what we were doing and told us he thought it was cool but he is heading to california, then after 20 seconds he yelled over to us "Fck it ill take you guys to Kingman AZ" (1+ hour drive in the OPPOSITE direction from where he is going) SHOUTOUT TO HIM HE IS AWESOME FOR THAT (oh yeah he bought us cold waters!)

Saw Lee and Jake standing by the I-40 East ramp with their cardboard sign. Turned around at the next exit to pick them up. Spent 3 hours sharing hot diner coffee and talking about family, faith, and music across the Mojave desert.
Picked up the boys right outside Albuquerque. Taught them how truckers communicate on CB radio channel 19. They shared their mission with me—it gave me renewed hope for the younger generation.
Was nervous at first, but seeing their big smiles and clean backpacks made me pull over. Best 4-hour road conversation I've had in years. They bought me a slice of pecan pie at the rest stop!
